doc.name: Buhalteris.ai
doc.instructions: Lithuanian tax information for small partnerships (mažoji bendrija, MB) and the self-employed (individuali veikla, verslo liudijimas), from buhalteris.ai. Everything is read-only and public. For a figure, call a calculator or get_tax_rates instead of recalling a rate: results carry the tax year, the date checked and the primary sources. For rules, deadlines and comparisons, call search_guides with Lithuanian keywords, then get_guide. Guide text, labels and notes are in Lithuanian. Amounts in `cents` are integer euro cents. When you answer, cite the buhalteris.ai URL and the primary source from the result, state the tax year, and say that this is general information, not tax advice.

tools.name: get_tax_rates
tools.title: Lithuanian tax rates and thresholds (mokesčių tarifai)
tools.description: The rates, thresholds and constants behind the buhalteris.ai calculators for 2026 or 2027: minimum monthly wage (MMA), average wage (VDU), tax-free amount (NPD), income tax (GPM) rates and brackets, Sodra contribution rates (VSD, PSD), contribution ceilings (lubos), business certificate amounts (verslo liudijimas) and small partnership (MB) profit tax and dividend rates. Use for "koks GPM tarifas", "kokia MMA", "Sodros įmokų tarifai", "NPD dydis". Money is in integer euro cents and rates in hundredths of a percent (permyriad): 1252 means 12.52 percent. `preliminary` lists the fields that still come from a draft; `computed` lists the amounts derived from MMA because the agency has not published them.

tools.name: calculate_vat
tools.title: VAT calculator (PVM skaičiuoklė)
tools.description: Lithuanian VAT (PVM, pridėtinės vertės mokestis): add VAT to a net amount or take it out of a gross amount, at the 21, 12, 5 percent rates in force. Use for "kiek PVM nuo sumos", "suma su PVM", "suma be PVM". Row ids: be-pvm (amount without VAT), pvm (the VAT), su-pvm (amount with VAT).

amount.description: The amount to convert. In euros, at most 2 decimal places.

direction.description: "add": amount is without VAT, add it (pridėti). "remove": amount already includes VAT, take it out (išimti).

tools.name: calculate_salary
tools.title: Salary calculator (atlyginimo skaičiuoklė)
tools.description: Lithuanian employment salary (darbo užmokestis pagal darbo sutartį): from gross (bruto, "ant popieriaus") to net (į rankas) or from net to gross, with income tax (GPM), the tax-free amount (NPD), employee and employer Sodra contributions (VSD, PSD) and the total cost to the employer (darbo vietos kaina). Use for "kiek į rankas nuo bruto", "kiek kainuoja darbuotojas", "alga ant popieriaus". Not for payouts to a member of a small partnership (MB narys). Row ids: bruto (gross), npd (tax-free amount applied), gpm (income tax), pensija, liga, motinyste, psd, kaupimas (employee contributions), darbuotojo-imokos (employee contributions total), i-rankas (net pay), nedarbas, nelaimingi, garantinis, ilgalaikis (employer contributions), darbdavio-imokos (employer contributions total), grindys-darbuotojo and grindys-darbdavio (minimum-contribution top-up, only below the minimum wage), darbo-vietos-kaina (total employer cost).

amount.description: Monthly salary: gross or net, as `direction` says. In euros, at most 2 decimal places.

direction.description: "gross": amount is the gross salary (bruto), compute net. "net": amount is the net pay (į rankas), compute gross.

contract.description: Employment contract type: open_ended (neterminuota) or fixed_term (terminuota). It changes the employer's unemployment insurance rate. Omitted: open_ended.

additional_pension.description: true when the employee pays the additional pension accumulation contribution (papildomas pensijų kaupimas). Omitted: false.

minimum_floor_waived.description: true when the minimum-contribution floor (Sodros įmokų „grindys“) does not apply this month. The site lists the cases: another job, a pension, age under 24, 0–55 percent work capacity, or a maternity, paternity or childcare benefit. It matters only below the minimum monthly wage (MMA). Omitted: false.

tools.name: calculate_individual_activity_tax
tools.title: Individual activity tax calculator (individualios veiklos mokesčiai)
tools.description: Annual taxes of a self-employed person in Lithuania working under an individual activity certificate (individuali veikla pagal pažymą, IV): income tax (GPM) with its credit, and Sodra contributions (VSD, PSD). Use for "kiek mokesčių nuo individualios veiklos pajamų", "IV mokesčiai", "GPM, VSD ir PSD nuo pajamų". Row ids: pelnas (profit), gpm-baze (income tax base), kreditas (income tax credit), gpm (income tax), sodros-baze (contribution base), vsd (social insurance), psd-nuo-pajamu (health insurance on income), psd-minimumas (monthly health insurance minimum), psd (health insurance payable), viso (GPM + VSD + PSD).

income.description: Income from the activity for the year (pajamos). In euros, at most 2 decimal places.

expense_method.description: "actual": deduct the expenses given in `expenses` (faktinės išlaidos). "flat_30": deduct a flat 30 percent of income instead (30 % išlaidų). Omitted: actual.

expenses.description: Deductible expenses for the year (leidžiami atskaitymai), without VSD and PSD: the calculator subtracts those itself. Only with expense_method "actual"; must not exceed income. Omitted: 0. In euros, at most 2 decimal places.

months.description: Months of activity in the year (veiklos mėnesiai per metus); the monthly health insurance minimum is counted for each. Omitted: 12.

additional_pension.description: true when the person pays the additional pension accumulation contribution (papildomas pensijų kaupimas). Omitted: false.

health_insured_elsewhere.description: true when a job or the state already covers health insurance (PSD jau dengia darbas arba valstybė): the monthly PSD minimum is then not counted, PSD on income still is. Omitted: false.

tools.name: calculate_business_certificate_cost
tools.title: Business certificate cost calculator (verslo liudijimo sąnaudos)
tools.description: Cost of working under a Lithuanian business certificate (verslo liudijimas) for a period: the fixed income tax set by the municipality (fiksuotas GPM), which the caller supplies, plus Sodra social insurance (VSD) and health insurance (PSD) for that period. Use for "kiek kainuoja verslo liudijimas", "verslo liudijimo mokesčiai mėnesiui". The fixed income tax differs by municipality and activity; find it with search_guides (for example "verslo liudijimo kainos savivaldybėse"). Row ids: dienos (number of days, not money), gpm (fixed income tax), vsd, psd, viso (total), menuo-1 … menuo-12 (VSD and PSD per calendar month).

start_date.description: First day the certificate is valid (nuo), YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Last day the certificate is valid (iki), YYYY-MM-DD. Same tax year as start_date.

fixed_income_tax.description: The fixed income tax for the whole period as set by the municipality (fiksuotas GPM). 0 when the municipality sets none. In euros, at most 2 decimal places.

health_insurance.description: How health insurance (PSD) is counted: full_month (the whole month whenever the certificate is valid at least one day of it, visas mėnuo), by_day (in proportion to the days, only for a person already insured elsewhere, proporcingai dienoms), none (no PSD: a residential rental certificate, PSD nėra). Omitted: full_month.

additional_pension.description: true when the person pays the additional pension accumulation contribution (papildomas pensijų kaupimas). Omitted: false.

social_insurance_exempt.description: true to leave social insurance (VSD) out (VSD neskaičiuok). The site names two cases: the first year of self-employment, or a residential rental certificate. The calculator does not check the condition. Omitted: false.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.title: Search buhalteris.ai guides (gidų paieška)
tools.description: Keyword search over the 39 Lithuanian guides on buhalteris.ai about small partnerships (mažoji bendrija, MB), individual activity (individuali veikla, IV), business certificates (verslo liudijimas), VAT (PVM), income tax (GPM), the tax-free amount (NPD), health and social insurance (PSD, VSD), founding a company, bank accounts and accounting prices. Query in Lithuanian for the best match; diacritics and word endings do not matter ("mokesciai" finds "mokesčių"). It matches words in the title, description, summary and FAQ questions; it is not a semantic search. Returns each guide's URL, summary, checked date, status and primary sources, best match first. status is "patikrinta" (checked against the sources), "atnaujinama" (being updated) or "hipotezė" (a hypothesis, not confirmed). Read the full text with get_guide.

query.description: Keywords, for example "PVM registracija MB" or "verslo liudijimas 2027". Words of one letter are ignored.

limit.description: How many results to return at most. Omitted: 5. There is no upper bound; a number above the match count returns every match.

totalMatches.description: Guides that matched, before `limit` was applied.

markdownUrl.description: The full rendered page as Markdown.

sources.description: Primary sources (VMI, Sodra, legal acts) behind the figures.

score.description: Match score; higher is better. Comparable only within one result list.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.title: Read a buhalteris.ai guide (gido tekstas)
tools.description: The full text of one buhalteris.ai guide as Markdown (Lithuanian), with its canonical URL, checked and updated dates, status, primary sources and FAQ. Give the slug from search_guides (for example "patarimai/npd-2027"), the page URL or its .md URL. status is "patikrinta" (checked against the sources), "atnaujinama" (being updated) or "hipotezė" (a hypothesis, not confirmed). A few guides are built from data components; for those `body` is null, `bodyNote` says why, and the rendered text is at `markdownUrl`.

guide.description: Slug ("patarimai/npd-2027"), page URL ("https://buhalteris.ai/patarimai/npd-2027/") or Markdown URL ("https://buhalteris.ai/patarimai/npd-2027.md").
